messages.content: 計算一條載有4安培電流的電線所產生的磁場，距離電線2公尺。並找出一個距離電場方向3公尺的區域的電壓差，假設電場為5牛頓/庫侖。

function.name: calculate_voltage_difference
function.description: Calculate the voltage difference between two points in an electric field. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

electric_field.description: The electric field in newtons per coulomb. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance between the two points in the direction of the field in meters. This is a float type value.

charge.description: The charge of the test particle, typically an electron, in coulombs. Default to 0 This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_magnetic_field
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field produced by a current-carrying wire. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

current.description: The current in the wire in amperes. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The perpendicular distance from the wire in meters. This is a float type value.

permeability.description: The permeability of free space, a constant value. Default 0.1 This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute magnetic field using Biot-Savart law: B = μ0 I / (2π r). But the function calculate_magnetic_field expects parameters: current, distance, permeability default 0.1. So we call with current=4, distance=2, permeability=0.1. That will compute B.

Then compute voltage difference: V = E * d * q? Wait formula: Potential difference ΔV = E * d * q? Actually potential difference between two points in uniform electric field: ΔV = -E·d (if along field direction). But the function calculate_voltage_difference expects electric_field, distance, charge optional. It likely calculates V = E * distance * charge? But typical formula: V = E * d (if charge is 1 coulomb?). But they include charge param maybe to compute work done on charge: W = q E d. But they ask "電壓差" which is potential difference independent of charge. So maybe they want V = E * distance. But the function signature includes charge optional default 0. So maybe they want to compute work done: W = q * E * d. But the question: "找出一個距離電場方向3公尺的區域的電壓差，假設電場為5牛頓/庫侖。" They want voltage difference across 3 m in field of 5 N/C. So V = E * d = 5 * 3 = 15 V. So we can call calculate_voltage_difference with electric_field=5, distance=3, charge omitted. The function may compute V = E * distance * charge? If charge omitted, default 0, then result 0. That would be wrong. So maybe we need to pass charge=1? But default 0 leads to zero. So we should pass charge=1 to get 15. But the function signature says charge default 0. So we need to override. So call with charge=1.

Thus we produce results: Magnetic field B = μ0 I / (2π r). With μ0 default 0.1? That seems unrealistic; actual μ0 = 4π*10^-7 H/m ~ 1.256637e-6. But they set default 0.1. So B = 0.1 * 4 / (2π * 2) = 0.4 / (4π) = 0.4 / 12.566370614359172 = 0.031830988618379067 T. So about 0.0318 Tesla.

Voltage difference: V = E * d * charge? If charge=1, V = 5 * 3 * 1 = 15 V. So answer: B ≈ 0.0318 T, V ≈ 15 V.

We need to call the functions. Use the tool.
